data.narrative:
Netrasemi is a Series A-stage semiconductor company founded by Jyothis Indirabhai, Deepa Geetha, and Sreejith Varma, having raised approximately $13M to date. The broader Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 11 private peers and 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD), though the company operates within a narrow frontier-tech subset alongside ventures like SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to Netrasemi due to insufficient depth in the narrow peer set. Only one same-stage and one adjacent-stage comparable exist within the sector, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum required for reliable median-based triangulation. Broadening to all 11 sector peers would introduce heterogeneity across stage, business model, and maturity that would render any median estimate misleading rather than instructive.

Without applicable triangulation methods, a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the data provided. The analysis is constrained by the sparsity of direct comparables at Netrasemi's stage and within its specialized semiconductor subsector. Future valuation work would require either (1) expansion of the peer universe to include earlier-stage or adjacent frontier-tech hardware ventures, or (2) application of alternative methods such as venture-backed pricing precedent or revenue multiple analysis, contingent on availability of financial metrics. The key uncertainty remains the absence of sufficient comparable transactions to anchor a range.
